study.question: Can retaining the compressed feedback-stratum contrast in a task-specific residual representation improve click AUC over both frozen source bests, and is that improvement greater than shared residual fusion or extra task-specific capacity using only the incumbent pool? Observation: g0-r0007-anchored_task_query achieved 0.6604926719194907 versus g0-r0007-anchor_shared_query/incumbent 0.660646940486458; the matched zero-empty-input cells achieved 0.6591771065580436 and 0.6591475705682285. Round6 compressed task/shared cells (0.6591942389399411/0.6592467764762769) also trailed event controls (0.660163362657485/0.6602152531450661). Thus task-specific scalar rows have not shown useful complementarity, while scorer population is consequential. Source inspection additionally shows the already computed N/A pools are summed for auxiliaries and omitted from the click readout; that structural bottleneck, not a proven cause of the null results, motivates this experiment. Auxiliary performance remains a material limitation: incumbent cart/fav/buy AUCs 0.6641532/0.7095960/0.6688015 versus DIN 0.8490697/0.8648975/0.8701823. The initial DIN adaptation is a measured reference, not exact original-paper reproduction. These are single-seed validation observations, with no independent replication or bootstrap intervals.
study.hypothesis: The compression stage preserves a feedback distinction that the current pooled readout discards. Let U,N,A be the count-weighted, target-scored uniform, nonauxiliary and auxiliary-history pools; p is the fraction of valid history events in the union of historical cart/fav/buy masks. The centered contrast d=A-p*(N+A) may encode feedback-related target affinity beyond the incumbent pool. Task-specific context/target-conditioned residual maps may use this distinction differently for click and auxiliary labels, whereas prior affine scorer rows could change click only indirectly through shared context learning. This is a new, untested explanation; the data do not establish that discarded strata are predictive. Apply h_t=base_t+1[n>0]*R_t(concat(context_t,target_t,d_t)), where base_click=U and base_aux=N+A. Auxiliary d/target/history paths retain the source gradient stops; context remains trainable. The hypothesis concerns useful complementarity of this implementation, not a universal claim about history compression or task conditioning.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text, lines250-277, verifies target-conditioned local activation and unnormalized interest-intensity pooling. This proposal inherits those operators through the adapted local source, adds fixed UF compression and centered feedback residuals with task-specific versus shared maps; it is not a reproduction of original DIN.

Frozen local source is the empirical parent and actual code ancestor. Preserve its compression/scorer/towers and gradient ownership; add a zero-output residual bank after original initialization, with identical tower input width.

Existing task-conditioned affine scorer rows did not beat matched shared rows. This proposal leaves the scalar scorer untouched and conditions a nonlinear pooled representation on task identity, context, target and feedback contrast. These are different interventions; a gain cannot retroactively validate task-specific scorer rows.

Pinned benchmark primary implementation lines129-237 uses recent/earlier sequences, fixed and feature-conditioned queries, heterogeneous interaction and mean token readout. This proposal uses existing UF block means and a centered feedback residual after a single scalar scorer; no query-mixed tokenizer or heterogeneous token mixer is adopted. Original paper paper:hemix has provenance only; tools read returned no detailed text and its benchmark fallback was inspected. Original-paper novelty and equivalence remain unverified.

Cached section2.3 describes UniMixer flatten/chunk mixing, LONGER local compression/repeated interaction and INFNet task-hub aggregation. They are relevant families, not local evidence or mandatory architectures. The present experiment is a minimal residual test of a local information bottleneck; no architecture-priority claim is made.

inherited_components: g2-r0004-context_only: FeatureEmbeddingDict and supplied field selection; six target/history item fields and historical action embedding; actual labels and host-filtered inputs.

g2-r0004-context_only: action-aware DIN scalar scorer, Dice and same empty-slot query interactions; four prediction towers and source source-path gradient stops, including cloned auxiliary Dice buffers.
g0-r0007 source anchoring principle: add new modules after inherited reset and restore CPU RNG; this is reused implementation practice, not evidence of the new mechanism.
Host frozen input, optimizer, training, validation scorer and resource ledger; no host-owned artifact was edited.
study.proposed_difference: Add four adapters R_j(z)=W2_j*ReLU(W1_j*z+b1_j)+b2_j of width16, with W2/b2 zero initially. At each task, evaluate all four adapters on the same task inputs. Task routing selects adapter j matching feature_map.labels; shared routing averages the four outputs. This gives identical allocated parameters and forward module calls across four cells; shared mode has a shared nonlinear ensemble and task mode specialized members. Contrast cells supply d=A-p*(N+A); capacity controls supply base_t instead of d, giving no additional history view beyond the incumbent tower input. All cells add the correction to the incumbent pooled vector before the unchanged tower, and mask corrections for empty histories. No extra stateful normalization, scorer rows, input fields, labels, temporal information, loss weighting or training changes are introduced. The centered contrast is exactly zero for homogeneous auxiliary/nonauxiliary histories but the conditioned adapter can still learn a context-only correction; capacity controls address that possibility. The source representation, compression, interactions, auxiliary functional scorer and pooling helpers are AST-identical to the frozen ancestor in every file. No scientific novelty or new measured performance is asserted.
predictions: Primary prediction: AUC(task_contrast) exceeds both source bests g2-r0004-context_only=0.660646940486458 and g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary=0.660163362657485 under the frozen full protocol, and exceeds shared_contrast and task_capacity.

Interaction prediction: I=[AUC(task_contrast)-AUC(shared_contrast)]-[AUC(task_capacity)-AUC(shared_capacity)] is positive. Report all four simple effects and I, not only the winning cell; a positive main effect alone does not establish complementarity.

At initialization, all four variants should match incumbent probabilities in train/eval under matching inputs/state, and the first inherited scorer/tower gradients should match when adapter final projections are zero. New final adapter layers should receive gradients on nonempty histories; first-layer gradients are expected to be zero on the first backward pass by construction.

Predeclared diagnostics when the host supports them: click history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64; composition bins no aux, mixed, all aux using valid released masks. Report sample/positive/negative counts and mark slices with either class absent as insufficient. Additional slice exploration is exploratory. Never infer independent observations from repeated user exposures.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values and auxiliary mean separately. Expected parameter increase is33,280 dense parameters (+0.104% total, +12.45% dense, conditional on source input width400/value width112); host must measure counts, allocated GPU seconds, wall time, peak memory, processed examples, throughput and p50/p95 latency. Same data passes isolate the intervention; measured equal-compute superiority is not established by this suite alone.

Soft cost target: no more than25% wall-time overhead against a contemporaneous source replay. Exceeding it rejects the inexpensive-fusion prediction even if quality improves, and requires a measured quality-cost comparison before efficiency claims.
falsifiers: A successful, contract-valid task_contrast run failing to exceed the stronger source best does not support useful complementarity in this implementation. One null initialization is not universal mechanism refutation; retain the result and consider a discriminating follow-up only with remaining resources.

If task_capacity matches/exceeds task_contrast, the gain is consistent with added conditional nonlinear capacity rather than the extra feedback view. If shared_contrast matches/exceeds task_contrast or the interaction I is nonpositive, task-specific feedback complementarity is unsupported.

If the gain vanishes under paired seed repetitions or authorized paired user-cluster uncertainty estimates, retain it as a single-seed fluctuation. No significance claim is allowed from this initial seed.

Initialization/parity, finite forward/backward, mask invariance, causal-input or gradient ownership failure is an implementation failure. Do not label it scientific counterevidence or execute a changed frozen protocol.
A gain caused by changed Dice population/state, source RNG draws, increased data passes, labels or visibility breaches the intended contrast and cannot support the mechanism.
If capacity/cost-matched follow-up explains the advantage, withdraw any efficiency/complementarity interpretation. Auxiliary degradation must remain visible even when click selection favors a model.
alternative_explanations: Additional nonlinear feature interaction or context-only residuals may explain gains without any value from feedback contrast; compare the base-input capacity cells.

Task versus shared banks change effective per-task capacity, gradient interference and averaging scale: equal allocated parameters and forward calls do not match effective function class or optimizer dynamics. Shared averages four outputs; each task-specific path uses one member. Do not claim isolated task semantics solely from the interaction.

The centered contrast has different scale/distribution from the base pool; a positive contrast effect could include conditioning or optimization benefits. A scale-matched sham/permuted feedback control is a prospective follow-up, not an executed control.

Auxiliary losses can change shared context and shared-bank parameters but do not update item/action/scorer paths. Cross-field embedding aliases could complicate parameter ownership; preserve the computational path claim and require the host alias audit before source-table ownership claims.

One-epoch learning, zero-output residual warm-up, fixed seed and validation reuse can favor an implementation. Three paired seeds and user-cluster intervals are required for stronger support where interfaces permit.

Official_offline delayed feedback visibility and whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots are inherited assumptions. These results would establish only the released offline benchmark, not production point-in-time validity. Shopping labels match user/category/brand over24h, not ad-specific conversions.

Round7 negative empty-input results implicate the scored population but do not prove a BatchNorm mechanism; no BN diagnostics were measured. Keeping that population fixed controls this uncertainty for the proposed suite.
